text:
Type: black picture frame with white mat
Use: displaying photos, art prints or posters; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: wood-look frame in a matte black finish, white mat board, clear glazing
Colors: matte black, white, light grey insert
Shape: upright rectangle in a slim square-edged profile, generous white mat framing the picture, flat front and crisp corners, simple and light
